items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: we used to call him, he was really from the island, we called him a Jewmaker.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Who did Rene have on banjo? Can you remember?
Yes, there was, uh, one fella named Son, and then he had a fella, we used to call him, he was really from the island, we called him a Jewmaker.
